title: Film your lights in slow motion
pause_note: Shorts v4: DO hook (phone already filming a ceiling LED at 0 s), slow-motion reveal of the pulsing bulb at ~7-9 s, loop ending

beats: Point your phone at a ceiling light. Switch to slow motion.
Some lights are pulsing, a hundred or a hundred and twenty times a second.
That is twice the rate of the power in your wall.
Your eyes blur it into a steady glow. The camera's quick snapshots catch the dips.
Good LEDs barely flicker. Cheap or dimmed ones often do. Go check yours.
